content.text:
Avi, this is how it went. **After 8 years I'd get about 68,853 ₪ back. For 4 years the page wouldn't give me a number at all.** I'm fairly sure of the 8-year number. For 4 years I'll have to ask you or the bank.

**What I did:**
- At the top, the page said that 6 years after the first deposit you can take the money out without tax.
- I pressed "מה קורה לכסף בקרן" (what happens to the money in the fund) and chose "עצמאים" (self-employed).
- I didn't change the numbers it suggested: a 500 ₪ deposit every month, "תשואה בשנה 7" (7% return a year), and "דמי ניהול 0.54" (0.54% management fee).
- Under the chart there is a row of years from 1 to 12, and I tapped the one I wanted.
  - **8 years:** the big white column, "נשאר בידיים" (left in your hands), says 68,853 ₪. Next to it: deposits 48,000, tax refund +9,581, and return +11,272. The tax column was 0.
  - **4 years:** an orange note says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים". So for the self-employed it doesn't calculate taking the money out before 6 years. You'd pay tax as on business income, on the profit and on the deposits you got a deduction for.

The only number there was 25,725, and it belongs to a different column, "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך" (the same money in a securities account). That isn't the fund, so I didn't take it as my answer. Even on 8 there was a 55,471 in that same column, and at first I wasn't sure which number was mine.

**What I didn't understand:**
- "במסלול מדד". To me the מדד is the price index from the news.
- "הכנסה חייבת" (taxable income), "החזר המס" (the tax refund), and the purple dotted lines under the numbers.

**What bothered me:**
- The 7% return is just filled in for you. Nobody promises it.
- The screen is black, and the grey line "גררו את הסמן..." (drag the marker...) is hard to read.
- I didn't read anything below the calculator.

input.answer: With the page's own numbers (500 ₪ a month, 7% a year), after 8 years about 68,853 ₪ is "נשאר בידיים"; for 4 years the calculator gives no figure for self-employed people, it only says that taking money out before 6 years is taxed like business income.

stuck.why: Only number shown was 25,725 under 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', not for the fund itself; orange note says no calculation for self-employed before 6 years
Two big numbers side by side (68,853 and 55,471); had to work out which one was mine

used: year buttons under the chart (4 and 8)
orange note about withdrawal before 6 years
not_found: an amount after 4 years for a self-employed person

Dark background and small grey helper text hard to read
'מסלול מדד' unexplained for someone who knows מדד only as the price index
